[[File:Laser_trigger.png|thumb|right|250px|Republic senators trapped by laser webs]]
'''Laser webs''' were a type of trap. A large number of lasers would be fired at a target who set them off, hopefully killing them. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] used them is his [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raid]] on the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to trap the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was also known to use laser webs to lock down the [[Holocron Chamber]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used laser webs in his trap for [[Jodo Kast]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], but Kast avoided them.
